jobs.name: Clio III oil and filter change
jobs.tools: Ramps or axle stands, sump plug spanner, filter wrench, drip tray, funnel
steps: Run the engine for a few minutes so the oil flows, then switch off.
Raise the front safely on ramps or axle stands; never work under a car held only by a jack.
Put a drip tray under the sump, undo the drain plug and let the oil drain fully.
Fit a new washer to the plug and tighten it to the manual's torque.
Remove the old filter, oil the new filter's seal, and fit it hand-tight plus the turn the manual gives.
Fill with the specified oil to just below the dipstick's maximum.
Start, check for leaks, switch off, wait, and top up to the mark.
Reset the service reminder and dispose of the old oil at a recycling centre.

jobs.name: Clio III front brake pads and discs
jobs.tools: Jack, axle stands, socket set, torque wrench, piston tool, brake cleaner
steps: Loosen the wheel bolts, raise the car on axle stands and remove the wheel.
Undo the caliper guide bolts and lift the caliper off; hang it so the hose is not stretched.
Remove the old pads and, for discs, the carrier and disc retaining screw.
Measure the disc thickness against the minimum stamped on it; replace if under or lipped.
Clean the carrier, fit new discs and pads, and push the piston back slowly.
Refit with the bolts at the manual's torque, pump the pedal until firm, and check the fluid level.
Bed in the pads with several gentle stops before any hard braking.

jobs.name: Clio III timing belt
jobs.tools: Engine locking kit for the engine, torque wrench, socket set, engine support
steps: Support the engine and remove the right-hand engine mount and the auxiliary belt.
Turn the engine to its timing position and fit the locking pins for that engine.
Release the tensioner and take off the old belt and pulleys, and the water pump if it is belt-driven.
Fit the new pump, pulleys and belt in the maker's order, set the tensioner to its mark.
Remove the pins, turn the engine two full turns by hand and check the marks and tension again.
Refit the mount and belt, and record the date and mileage.

jobs.name: Clio III spark plugs
jobs.tools: Spark plug socket, extension, torque wrench, gap gauge, code reader
steps: Let the engine cool and remove the engine cover.
Unplug and lift out each coil pack in turn.
Undo the plug, check the new plug's gap, and thread it in by hand first.
Tighten to the manual's torque and refit the coil.
Start and check for a smooth idle and no warning light.

jobs.name: Clio III glow plugs
jobs.tools: Deep socket, torque wrench, multimeter, copper grease
steps: Test each plug's resistance with a multimeter to find the failed ones.
Disconnect the battery and the plug feeds.
Undo each plug gently; stop and soak with penetrating oil if it binds, as they can snap.
Fit new plugs with a light anti-seize on the threads, at the manual's torque.
Reconnect and check the glow light goes out as it should.

jobs.name: Clio III coolant flush
jobs.tools: Drip tray, hose clip pliers, funnel, refractometer
steps: Work only on a cold engine: a hot cooling system can scald.
Drain the old coolant from the radiator drain or bottom hose into a tray.
Flush with clean water until it runs clear.
Refill with the specified coolant mix through the expansion tank.
Open the bleed screws and run the engine with the heater on hot until the air is out.
Check the level again when cold and top up.

jobs.name: Clio III headlamp bulb
steps: Open the bonnet and remove the cover or cap behind the headlamp.
Unclip the connector and the retaining spring.
Fit the new bulb without touching its glass, refit the spring, connector and cover.
Check both dipped and main beams work and the aim looks right on a wall.

jobs.name: E30 timing belt
jobs.tools: Socket set, torque wrench, fan clutch spanner, timing marks on crank and cam
steps: Remove the viscous fan, the auxiliary belts and the upper timing cover.
Turn the crank to top dead centre on cylinder 1 and line up the cam sprocket mark.
Release the tensioner and remove the old belt.
Fit the new tensioner and belt with the marks aligned, set the tension.
Turn the engine two full turns by hand and check the marks again.
Refit the covers, belts and fan; record the date and mileage.

jobs.name: E30 spark plugs, cap and rotor
jobs.tools: Spark plug socket, extension, torque wrench, gap gauge, screwdriver
steps: Label the HT leads, then pull them off by the boots, not the wire.
Undo each plug, gap the new one, thread it in by hand and torque it.
Unclip the distributor cap, pull off the rotor arm, fit the new rotor and cap.
Refit the leads in the same order and check for a clean start and idle.
